name: Retailer Payment Result 8
definition: Data related to the result of a processed payment transaction.

PaymentInstrument.name: Payment Instrument
PaymentInstrument.definition: Set of payment instruments relevant to this transaction.

PaymentTypeInformation.name: Payment Type Information
PaymentTypeInformation.definition: Further details related to the set of payment types.

AdditionalService.name: Additional Service
AdditionalService.definition: Service provided by the card payment transaction, in addition to the main service.

ServiceAttribute.name: Service Attribute
ServiceAttribute.definition: Additional attribute of the service type.

CustomerOrder.name: Customer Order
CustomerOrder.definition: Customer order attached to a customer, recorded in the POI system.

ImageCapturedSignature.name: Image Captured Signature
ImageCapturedSignature.definition: Numeric value of a handwritten signature.

ProtectedCapturedSignature.name: Protected Captured Signature
ProtectedCapturedSignature.definition: Protected value of a handwritten signature.

MerchantOverrideFlag.name: Merchant Override Flag
MerchantOverrideFlag.definition: Indicate that the Merchant forced the result of the payment to successful.| Usage: When absent, default value is False.

CustomerLanguage.name: Customer Language
CustomerLanguage.definition: Language used to display messages to the customer.

OnlineFlag.name: Online Flag
OnlineFlag.definition: Indicate that the payment transaction processing has required the approval of an acquirer.| Usage: When absent, default value is False.
